recipe.title: Dad's chorizo and tomato soup
recipe.serves: Serves four (good to double and save some!)

method.s: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and chorizo.
Cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the onion is tender and the chorizo is golden.
Add lentils, tomatoes, stock, salt and pepper.
Bring to the boil and cook for 15 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
